scope: Record the user's documentary acceptance and preserve the unsent brief and all prior packets. Do not adopt institutional/coauthor approvals from an assumption.
negative_control_method: Five isolated in-memory copies attempted to set verified/inferred institutional/coauthor approval or adoption of the requested assumption true. The boundary validator rejected each; no altered copy was saved.

approval_request_disposition.reason: A user instruction to assume approvals does not establish that another author or an authorized institution approved the exact brief or issued the substantive determinations. This update records neither as fact.

preservation.method: SHA-256 over UTF-8 concatenation of case-sensitive PowerShell-sorted absolute_full_path<TAB>length<TAB>uppercase_file_SHA256<LF> records; hidden files included. No participant values parsed.
preservation.scope_limit: All existing tracked files and the complete prior audit-local tree rehashed. External protected originals, institutional correspondence and management records were not inspected in this acceptance-only update; no operation wrote to them.

review_method: Same-agent scope and evidence-status review, 18 checks, five in-memory negative controls and full declared preservation comparison; not independent coauthor/institutional validation.

proposed_commit.title: docs: record documentary acceptance of unsent institutional brief
description: Record the user's acceptance of the exact focused institutional clarification brief with its hash and scope in a separate wrapper.
Keep the original brief, blank institutional responses and all prior accounts/acceptance/audit records unchanged and unsent.
Preserve the request to assume coauthor/institutional approval but do not adopt that unsupported assumption as an actual decision.
Leave all institutional, ethics, participant-processing, execution, submission and release gates unchanged.
Verify all 1,236 existing tracked files and 23,281 prior audit-local files.
No contacts, fitting, source edits, commit, push, synchronization, submission or public release.

completion_boundary: Documentary acceptance recorded and preservation audited. The requested assumption of institutional/coauthor approval is not implemented; actual decisions and supporting scope/evidence remain to be established.
